description: SYNTHETIC disruption scenarios for a controlled before/after test. These are not observed events: locations are real Colombo areas, but radii and delays are stated assumptions. True added delay decays linearly from peak_delay_min at the centre to 0 at radius_km. Only observed_fraction of affected hotels receive a route signal (partial sensor coverage); gold is graded on the TRUE delay of every hotel. Travel times are left unchanged so the test isolates the disruption channel.

scenarios.name: Galle Face Green event with road closures

event.title: Scenario: large public event at Galle Face Green, approach roads closed

scenarios.rationale: An announced event: news coverage links an Event to every hotel in the zone (graded by distance) in addition to partial route signals. Tests the event channel.

scenarios.name: Unannounced road closure in Fort
scenarios.rationale: No news event, so only route sensors see it. Hotels without a sensor can only be down-ranked through NEAR_HOTEL diffusion.

scenarios.name: Galle Road lane closures, Bambalapitiya
scenarios.rationale: Milder, wider congestion south of the centre with no event. A second sensor-only case in a different part of the pool.
